Measured 2026-07-28 by re-running the sync and reading each warned node's environment: not one of the 33 nodes carries \leanok, \mathlibok or any other assertion that its Lean is written and checked. So the warnings are unresolved FORWARD CONTRACTS and renames, never a false "this is formalized" claim. That is the question the item was really asking, and it is now answered by measurement rather than by inspection of a sample. THE THREE CLASSES, by cause rather than by chapter:    (a) DELIBERATE FORWARD CONTRACTS, 7 of 33, pinned under the AlgebraicGeometry.TODO namespace, which exists precisely to make an unwritten target visible: TODO.rel_pic_etale_sheaf_unit_canonical, TODO.quotReductionToPiStarW, TODO.quotBoundedness, TODO.quotAlphaInjective, TODO.quotValuativeCriterion, TODO.stage6_regular_stalk_assembly, TODO.weilDivisorObstruction.
